# Round log line counts open findings and notes fixed ones

## What to build

After each review round the run logs `code review round N: X blocker, Y major, Z minor` (and `live test round N: ...`). The counts come from `countBySeverity` in `src/review/report.ts`, which counts every finding whatever its `status`, so findings a re-review marked `"fixed"` still show as blockers. Make `countBySeverity` count only findings whose status is not `"fixed"` (that is `"open"` or `"not_fixed"`), add an exported `countFixed(findings)` helper, and append ` (N fixed)` to the round log line when N > 0. With no fixed findings the line is unchanged. The fix-pass decision already uses only open findings (`openBlocking`), so it does not change.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `src/review/report.ts` (lines 11–25) — `findingSchema`; `status` is `"open" | "fixed" | "not_fixed"`
- `src/review/report.ts` (lines 209–213) — `countBySeverity`
- `src/review/report.ts` (lines 229–230) — `openBlocking`, the filter style to mirror (`f.status !== "fixed"`)
- `src/review/phase.ts` (lines 466–470) — the loop that logs `${name} round ${round}: ...`
- `src/review/phase-fix-pass.test.ts` (lines 303–309) — test "does not count a previous finding the reviewer marked fixed as open"; it currently expects `"code review round 1: 1 blocker, 0 major, 0 minor"`
- `src/review/phase.test.ts` (lines 27, 112, 120) and `src/review/phase-live-tester.test.ts` (lines 61, 144, 153) — other assertions on this line
- `src/review/report.test.ts` — unit tests for report helpers

## Patterns to follow

**Count helper shape:**
```ts
export function countBySeverity(findings: readonly Finding[]): Record<Severity, number> {
  const counts: Record<Severity, number> = { blocker: 0, major: 0, minor: 0 };
  for (const f of findings) counts[f.severity]++;
  return counts;
}
```

**Log line today (`src/review/phase.ts:467`):**
```ts
log(`${name} round ${round}: ${SEVERITIES.map((s) => `${counts[s]} ${s}`).join(", ")}`);
```

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `src/review/report.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: in `countBySeverity`, skip findings with `status === "fixed"`; update its doc comment to say it counts open findings. Add `export const countFixed = (findings: readonly Finding[]): number => findings.filter((f) => f.status === "fixed").length;`
- **VALIDATE**: `npx tsc --noEmit`

### UPDATE `src/review/phase.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: import `countFixed`; build the line as today and append `` ` (${fixed} fixed)` `` when `fixed > 0`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/review`

### UPDATE `src/review/report.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: tests that `countBySeverity` ignores fixed findings and counts `not_fixed` ones, and that `countFixed` counts only fixed ones.

### UPDATE `src/review/phase-fix-pass.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: the test at lines 303–309 now expects `"code review round 1: 0 blocker, 0 major, 0 minor (1 fixed)"`.
- **GOTCHA**: check every other assertion on this log line (`grep -rn "round [0-9]: " src/review`); only lines whose report has fixed findings change.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A round whose only finding was marked fixed logs `code review round 1: 0 blocker, 0 major, 0 minor (1 fixed)`
- [ ] A clean round still logs `code review round 0: 0 blocker, 0 major, 0 minor`
- [ ] `not_fixed` findings are counted as open
- [ ] Tests pass: `npx vitest run src/review`

## Validation commands

```bash
npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint .
npx vitest run src/review
```

Run every command with the graph-execution run variables unset, so the tests never touch a live run:
`env -u GRAPH_EXECUTION_RUNS_ROOT -u GRAPH_EXECUTION_RUN_ID -u GRAPH_EXECUTION_READY_FILE <command>`.
Stop only processes you started, by PID. Never use `pkill`/`killall` by name or pattern: other agents and graph-execution itself run on this machine.
